name: Chief Minister’s Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme - Tamil Nadu
benefit:
1. The scheme seeks to provide cashless hospitalization-specific ailments and procedures. 
1. The scheme provides coverage up to ₹ 5,00,000 per family per year on a floater basis for the ailments and procedures covered under the scheme.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
1. The applicant should have their name included in the family card.
1. The applicant’s family income should not exceed ₹1,20,000 per annum.
1. The applicant should submit a family card, an Aadhaar card, and an income certificate issued by VAO/Revenue Authorities, along with a self-declaration.
